$comment: LIVE-BUT-NOT-INSTALLED entity-type tokens, each with the reason it is allowed and the date it was allowed.
The vocabulary ships in @ai-matrx/associations and is declared "latest" here (THE LATEST LAW: no @ai-matrx
dependency is ever pinned). A token that lands in platform.entity_types therefore makes `pnpm check:entity-types`
RED for every release in this repo — release.sh:526 calls fail() — until the package is regenerated and published.
That window belongs to whoever added the token, not to every unrelated lane's deploy.
An entry here is a NAMED delta, not a blanket waiver. The check still FAILS on:
- any live token that is not listed here,
- any token installed but not live,
- a STALE entry: a token listed here that the installed package now carries, or that is no longer live.
A stale entry failing is what stops this file becoming a place tokens go to be forgotten.
ATTACK-6 findings 5 and 9c, 2026-09-16: rule 24 told the chair to PIN the package to 0.9.16 before W1-REG.
At 0.9.16 this gate exits 1, so executing rule 24 as written would have frozen the frontend release train for
the whole 59-hour campaign, taking every unrelated lane's deploys with it - and the pin also inverts the
workspace's standing law that @ai-matrx dependencies are latest/workspace:*. The pin is deleted; this is what
A field delta is the same class as a token delta: the live row moved, the package has not been republished yet. Listed per token+field, with the same staleness rule.
